description: Reads a Hugging Face model's public metadata: pipeline, license, GGUF quantizations, estimated VRAM in bytes and the engine that would serve it. Use it before propose_model. Gated repos need a Hugging Face token on the account. Read-only; no API key needed.

repo.description: Hugging Face repo "owner/model" or a huggingface.co URL.

name: probe_hf_model
title: Probe a Hugging Face model
